**Mutant Hounds**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5378e355d33745d1a2b036b37f446eb6~mv2.jpg)

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

To streamline this guide, I've only listed locations with 5 or more Super Mutant spawns.

Note: There is a 25% chance for Floaters to replace Mutant Hounds at locations with Super Mutation spawns when you are on a character that is level 50 and under.

**Fraternity Row - Unmarked Cabin** 

Super Mutants - 6

Mutant Hounds - 0

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3da34f5945214ab4b4088d35f111f8f6~mv2.jpg)

From the fast travel point, head South and follow the road until you reach the house with the blue door on the corner. Look to the East, and you’ll see a large metal power pylon behind the house. Run over and stand directly under the pylon, facing South.

From there, run forward until you reach the Cat House—it should be the first house you come across as you head South.

Once there, climb on top of the garage on the left side of the house and face East.

Run forward from the garage, and either go around or use a jetpack to get up the rock face. Keep running East until you reach the unmarked cabin. This is where the super mutants will spawn.
